question.knowledge_point: Finding the Y-Intercepts of a Hyperbola
question.worked_solution:
To find the $y$-intercepts of the hyperbola, we substitute $x=0$ into the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}25{y}^{2}-9{x}^{2} & =225 \\ 25{y}^{2}-9(0)^{2} & =225 \\ 25{y}^{2} & =225 \\ {y}^{2} & =9 \\ y & =\pm 3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $y$-intercepts are $(0,\pm 3).$
